Behind him are glass-walled offices and standard workplace furniture. (2) He bends down to lift a massive green bag, showing effort in his posture. (3) The scene shifts to reveal a colossal pink mascot character (Wang Beibei) in the center of the office; the man stands next to it to emphasize its towering scale. (4) The man is then shown lying on the floor under the giant mascot, laughing and gesturing wildly as if being 'born' from it, while the camera uses a medium full shot. (5) A young woman with long black hair, wearing a white t-shirt and holding bags, walks up a staircase and enters the office. (6) She reacts with intense surprise and laughter upon seeing the mascot; she covers her mouth and smiles, showing dental braces. (7) The man shows her a framed illustration while they stand in the open office environment with soft indoor lighting and computer monitors in the background.
